paths: ggml/src/ggml-cpu/iqk/iqk_gemm_kquants.cpp: Added an AVX-512 (512-bit) inner loop to the Q4_K/Q5_K-only dot kernel mul_mat_qX_K_q8_2_X4_T. DequantizerQ4K_AVX2 and DequantizerQ5K_AVX2 each gained a HAVE_FANCY_SIMD-gated prepare(i, j, __m512i * values512) that loads one 64B weight vector with _mm512_loadu_si512 and unpacks both nibble halves (and, for Q5_K, the 5-bit qh high-bit shifts via slli/and 0x10, grouped slli4->lo, slli3->hi, slli2->lo, slli1->hi to match the canonical HighBit5 layout) into four 512-bit values mirroring the existing 256-bit Q4Bits_AVX2 group layout, so the integer dot is bit-exact. The template's inner loop now has a #if HAVE_FANCY_SIMD && __AVX512VBMI2__ path that, per 256-element (2 x 128) j-step, does 2x 64B y-loads + 4x _mm512_dpbusd_epi32 (sub-block 2 via add_epi8 +32 to sign the y bytes) and a 4-way add reduction; it then computes per-32 scales directly from the make_q4_scales u8 layout (sc_l = d * u8[8*j + 0..3], sc_h = -dmin * u8[8*j + 8..11] as 512-bit vectors) instead of the pre-existing scales[2] array (which the 256-bit path reads out of bounds for j>1), converts the 512-bit int sum with _mm512_cvtps_ps, splits lo/hi 256-bit halves, and fmadd-accumulates against d8 + 8*j (lo -> sub-block 0 d, hi -> sub-block 1 d), keeping the float epilogue bit-identical to the per-32 reference. This halves the unpack/dpbusd/load instructions per weight byte vs the 256-bit path. The original 256-bit loop is kept as the #else fallback; shared Q4Bits_AVX2, Q6_K, dispatch, and headers are untouched. All new members/intrinsics are HAVE_FANCY_SIMD-guarded (matching the existing iqk_gemm_iqk_quants.cpp convention for _mm512_slli_epi16) so AVX2-only builds still compile.
